worldcombat.skill.mindreader.summary: Read one foe’s movement, briefly reveal it and show its current heading. Your next successful direct hit against that foe gains precision; attacks on other targets are unaffected.
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.use.0: See a strafing or retreating foe's heading before it slips away
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.use.1: Read an evasive foe before following up
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.use.2: Track a read target after it moves behind cover
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.description: Attacks against the read target use at least +%1$s Accuracy stages for %2$s. Other targets use your normal Accuracy.
The target is revealed for %1$s and stays visible through cover.
Read range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s. Single target, needs line of sight and range.
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.predict.on: Predict: the read and reveal last longer, but windup increases by %1$s and cooldown becomes %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.predict.off: Quick read: a shorter read and reveal, with a shorter windup and cooldown for a prompt follow-up.
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
When enabled, read duration is multiplied by 1.6 and reveal duration by 1.4, with a longer windup and cooldown. Disable for a quicker follow-up.
The companion only reads while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller reads at point-blank, larger approaches to read.
When on, a Hold order does not stop the companion from leaving its post to read.
worldcombat.skill.mindreader.description: The read fades after a direct hit deals damage to that target. A miss, a fully blocked hit, or an attack on someone else keeps the read until it expires or is removed.
